name: marriott-hotels
title_zh: 万豪官网实时房价，比价前先问它
tagline_zh: 比官网还快查到今晚最低价、积分兑换是否划算、公司协议价有没有房。挑酒店、定日期、排多晚连住，它替你跑遍全品牌。
tagline_en: Find tonight's lowest rate, points value, or corporate-code availability across Marriott brands—faster than the.
desc_en: Search Marriott hotels for live prices and availability with marriott-mcp. Use when picking or comparing hotels in a city, finding the cheapest night or date to travel, pricing a corporate/cluster rate code or a points redemption, or planning a multi-night stay across several properties.
why_zh: 直连万豪官方库存，不是抓页面猜数据。能同时比较现金价与积分价，把“哪晚最便宜”和“哪家还有房”一次算清。
why_en: Direct to Marriott's live inventory, not scraped pages. Compares cash vs points and isolates the cheapest night or date across.
limit_zh: 只覆盖万豪集团旗下酒店，不含希尔顿、洲际等竞对。需要联网且万豪官网可访问；不处理预订，只查价与房态。
limit_en: Marriott properties only—no Hilton or IHG. Requires internet and access to Marriott.com. It checks prices/availability but doesn't book; you finish.
title_en: Live Marriott rates & availability before you book
